title: libcuflynx params_for_id, JSON form (<prefix>_params_for_id.json)
description: The parameters a calibration identifies (version 1), a flat list of entries (libcuflynx/utilities/params_for_id_file.py). Read by ObsAndParamDataParser.get_param_id_info; a params_for_id CSV is refused, naming cuflynx-upgrade params-for-id, which converts it: vessel_name "a b" with param_name "C" -> targets ["a/C", "b/C"] (a nested vessel heart__lv as its path, heart/lv/C); min, max, param_type, name_for_plotting, prior, comment -> the same keys; the prior_* columns -> prior_params; unbounded -> unbounded (true/false). A parameter is named as users write it: <vessel>/<variable>, a nested vessel by its path (heart/lv/E_A, the model's heart__lv) and a global as global/<variable>. The document is then checked and defaults folded in by resolve_params_for_id_doc (libcuflynx/parsers/PrimitiveParsers.py), which also checks what JSON Schema cannot: unique names, registered modifier functions and their declared inputs, prior settings the chosen prior takes, a normal prior_mean within [min, max], min and max given unless unbounded, and no parameter both a target and modified, or modified twice. Other top-level keys are ignored.

version.description: The format version. Default: 1, the only one.

defaults.description: Keys applied to every entry; an entry's own key wins, and prior_params merge per setting. Default: {}.

params.description: Required. One entry per calibrated value.

qname.description: A model parameter as <vessel>/<variable> (e.g. "aortic_root/C"), a nested vessel by its path ("heart/lv/E_A", the model's heart__lv) and a global as "global/<variable>"; the variable follows the last "/".

name.description: The entry's name, unique in the file. Default: its first target (or first modified parameter).

targets.description: A parameter entry: the model parameters this one calibrated value sets (all to the same value). A single string is a one-item list. Give targets or modifies.

modifies.description: A modifier entry: the model parameters its calibrated value acts on, through the modifier function. None of them may also be a target, be modified by another entry, or be a modifier. Give targets or modifies.

modifier.description: Modifier entries only: the registered modifier function (built-in, funcs_user, or modifier_funcs_external_path). Default: "scale", one multiplier on every modified parameter's default value.

inputs.description: Modifier entries only: one value per input the modifier function declares, a qname for a "float" input or a non-empty list of qnames for a "list" input; the function receives their default values. Default: {} (required when the function declares inputs).

min.description: The lower bound of the calibrated value: of the uniform prior, the optimiser's search box and the sampling range. Required unless unbounded. For a scale modifier it is a multiplier, not a physical value.

max.description: The upper bound of the calibrated value. Required unless unbounded.

param_type.description: "const" (a constant) or "state" (an initial value). Deprecated and not read: give initial values to calibrate as constants of the module.

name_for_plotting.description: Label (LaTeX allowed) in plots and tables. Default: the first target, or a modifier's name.

prior.description: The prior distribution: "uniform" on [min, max], "normal" (prior_mean, prior_std) or "exponential" (prior_scale or prior_lambda, prior_origin), each truncated to [min, max] unless unbounded. The reader ignores case and surrounding whitespace. Default: "uniform".

prior_lambda.description: exponential: decay rate relative to max, used when prior_scale is not given. Default: 1.

prior_origin.description: exponential: where the decay starts. Default: 0.

prior_scale.description: exponential: decay scale in the parameter's units. Default: max / prior_lambda; required when unbounded.

prior_mean.description: normal: the centre, within [min, max]. Default: (min + max) / 2; required when unbounded.

prior_std.description: normal: the standard deviation. Default: (max - min) / 6; required when unbounded.

prior_params.description: The prior's settings; only those the prior takes may be given (see each). Default: {} (each setting's default).

unbounded.description: true: the parameter has no min/max of its own; its range is the prior's centre +/- 5 scales (normal: prior_mean, prior_std; exponential: prior_origin to + 5 prior_scale). Needs a normal or exponential prior. Also read: 1/0, yes/no, y/n. Default: false.

entryKeys.description: The keys an entry may have; any other key is refused.

entry.description: One calibrated value: a parameter entry (targets) or a modifier entry (modifies), not both. targets, modifies and the modifier keys may also come from defaults.

allOf.description: An entry is a parameter (targets) or a modifier (modifies), not both.
modifier and inputs apply to modifier entries only.
